{{Vanilla|Lantern}}
{{Infobox auto}}
A '''lantern''' is a hanging light source. [[Matcha Flavoured]] makes it cheaper.

== Obtaining ==
{{Recipes}}
Three iron nuggets around a [[torch]] make a lantern, instead of eight in vanilla; the vanilla recipe is removed.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/lantern.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/pack.mcmeta}}</ref>

=== Other sources ===
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==
{{Uses}}
The copper eye lantern is a developer item for building [[Abbey]] rooms; its recipe needs a {{MCW|Command Block|command block}}, so it cannot be crafted in survival.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/debug/recipe/copper_eye_lantern.json}}</ref> See [[Copper Eye#Copper eye door, grate and lantern]].
